findings.finding: Highly skewed self-report distribution; arithmetic mean does not describe an ordinary participant or justify a daily independent roll. Article calls six participants less than1% despite n194; inconsistent concentration percentage omitted. No participant data collected.

gaps.finding: Retrospective24-hour self-report, not probability sample or repeated diary; no national actor-frequency, detection or event-memory curve.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
